sentences.text: Shri Sampooran Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Ekta Gupta - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS (Section 439 of the Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 14.11.2024 in connection with Crime No.827/2024 registered at P.S.-Gorakhpur, District-Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n)
and 506 of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant established physical relation with prosecutrix on the false pretext of marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Incident is said to have occurred from 08.02.2021 to 05.07.2022.
FIR has been lodged on 13.11.2024.
There is delay in lodging FIR for which no explanation has been furnished.
Applicant is in jail since 14.11.2024.
It is urged that It is a case of consensual relationship.
No purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the bar.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Ashish Mishra be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
